_comment: Line-coverage gate for check-coverage.py. baseline = what CI itself measured on the merged report of every test project (Domain 76.1%, Application 75.5%, 2026-11-27); an earlier local run of the Domain.Tests project alone read 83.3%, which CI does not reproduce, so the gate is anchored on the CI number. A PR fails if an assembly is below its floor or more than ratchetTolerance points below its baseline. Ratchet: when CI shows improvement, record it as the new baseline and raise the floor. Issue #134 targets 80% Domain; that is NOT yet met (floor 74), so the issue stays open until the baseline reaches 80.
